caption: The compartment changes the RNA available to capture, and a barcode still needs identity checks. This invented droplet example includes a doublet and selective loss; preparation and capture shape the recovered set. An unobserved cell or state is not proof that it was absent from the tissue.
alt: A whole-cell cartoon contains nuclear and cytoplasmic RNA, while an isolated nucleus contains nuclear RNA including unfinished transcripts. In a droplet example, barcode A receives one cell, B one nucleus, and C two cells, showing that a barcode labels a reaction compartment rather than certifying one pure cell. An invented source-to-recovery cartoon drops one cell type during preparation/capture and shows ambient RNA outside a cell. Shapes, barcodes and recovery are invented; missing recovered cells or states do not establish biological absence.
